rate_scope: Standard processing, short text context, global official endpoint, no hosted paid tools
write_rate_choice: Use the published higher 12h write rate for every reported cache-write token even though requests do not set a TTL. This is a conservative estimate, not an invoice.
retention_field_note: Do not infer billing TTL from legacy response.prompt_cache_retention; later-model lifetime options are documented separately.
context_bound: 120000 UTF-8 request bytes plus 2048 framing allowance; observed input tokens checked against that bound and therefore below the 272K long-context threshold.
